rationale: Pratik and Mingze both work across ML infrastructure and LLM tooling—Pratik as an ML Engineer at Apple focused on LLM inference and model training, and Mingze as CTO of Secludy with deep expertise in PyTorch and model deployment. intro_message: Pratik Doshi, meet Mingze He — you're both focused on ML infrastructure and LLM tooling, and Mingze's perspective as a founding CTO could complement your production experience at Apple.
